lines.t: [INTRO – SPOKEN + RIFF]
(Spoken, low)
Yeah… banners up… boots on…
This is for the Throne that never flinched.Guitars hit with a snarling, palm‑muted riff, toms rolling like armor rolling in.
Crown don’t slip when He walks through fire,
Every dark king bow to the higher.
Steel in His eyes, thunder in His hand,
He owns the sky, He owns the land.
Raise that flag, let the whole world see,
There’s only one Boss of eternity.
All black thrones and the snakes they bred,
Fall like dust when He lifts His head.
Boots on the ground with the flame in His vein,
War in His step and a smile in the rain.
Every back‑room pact, every coded ring,
Come undone when the real King swings.
No ghost in the wires, no hidden court,
Can stand up straight when He cuts that cord.
He flips man’s chaos on the man who planned it,
Drops that gavel and the whole earth slams with it.He the storm in the desert, He the calm in the blast,
He the first roar comin’ and the last one to laugh.
He don’t need your vote or your praise on cue—
He gave the breath you cuss Him with, too.
You wanted crowns? He melts ’em down,
Forge ’em into chains, then He breaks ’em on the ground.
This is royal blood, not a borrowed throne,
Every rival god just skin and bone.
Crown don’t slip when He walks through fire,
Every dark king bow to the higher.
Steel in His eyes, thunder in His hand,
He owns the sky, He owns the land.
Raise that flag, let the whole world see,
There’s only one Boss of eternity.
All black thrones and the snakes they bred,
Fall like dust when He lifts His head.
He ride that line between wrath and grace,
Either lift you up or erase your face.
He bring holy chaos just to split your heart,
Let the poison rise, tear the lies apart.
You get two roads when the drums go still:
Kneel in the light or get broke on His will.
Either washed in fire till you shine like steel,
Or left with the night when the trumpets peel.Spirits in the shadows try to crowd His stage,
He turns their roar into a rusted cage.
Every curse they throw gets turned around,
Hits ’em in the chest when He shakes that ground.
He don’t share rooms with pretender kings,
He kicks in doors and He rips out strings.
From the pit to the palaces, one verdict fall:
Victor on high, and He owns it all.
Ooooh, let the mountains crack,
When the Lion takes it back.
Ooooh, let the war drums cease,
Every man choose war or peace.Gang shouts under it:
“ONE KING! NO TIES!
ALL DARK FALLS WHEN HE RISE!”
All your empires, all your ghosts,
All your deals in the dark…
One blaze from His face,
And it’s over.
